scope: Focused review corrections only. Full validation and exact seven-package policy requalification remain with the parent workflow.

exactMembershipFollowup.purpose: Independently refuses archive-present/library-absent as well as library-present/archive-absent.

corrections.finding: Static and environment-cleared subprocesses evade cooperative traces
corrections.fix: Kernel ptrace independently follows all threads and descendant process creation/exec; exact process/managed/native observation inventories must agree.
corrections.regression: Both actual subprocess forms write their execution marker successfully, then qualification refuses.

corrections.finding: Native bytes can execute and restore reviewed bytes before hashing; inferred package ownership
corrections.fix: Inotify watches directories and file inodes through preprocessing and Build; any mutation refuses, including atomic restoration. Package provenance requires exact membership in both library.files and the .nupkg.
corrections.regression: Changed native helper writes original2, atomically restores original bytes and still refuses; archive/library omission controls refuse independently.

corrections.fix: Preprocessing and Build use the same complete property/environment inputs and the same process/managed/native observers; imports are collected there.
corrections.regression: Full consumer fixture requires UseSharedCompilation=false for conditional.xml and proves one observed task execution.

corrections.fix: Shared typed command parsing requires explicit case-insensitive boolean Enabled.
corrections.regression: Missing/null controls refuse scope, validation, digest and registered adapter; all three casing forms of explicit false succeed.

corrections.finding: Cancellation during directory await can become NotFound
corrections.fix: Check cancellation immediately after the await before foreign scope classification.
corrections.regression: Actual cancellation during the foreign-directory read yields a canceled task/token and zero commands/model state/scheduling effects.

corrections.finding: Duplicate JSON surfaces as infrastructure failure
corrections.fix: Malformed governance input throws the existing ArgumentException client-validation contract.
corrections.regression: Raw HTTP duplicate/missing/null JSON returns nonretryable 400/correct_request with no admission record or aggregate/model callback.

corrections.finding: Unsupported platforms and prerequisite diagnostics are late/implicit
corrections.fix: Complete consumer entry checks Linux/glibc/cc/inotify; compiles and probes permitted ptrace before any consumer restore or SDK build. Native fixture static-link prerequisites fail explicitly.
corrections.regression: Unsupported consumer entry invokes no restore/build/child tools; missing compiler diagnostics tested; no qualification skips.

corrections.finding: Fileless refusal branches lack actual execution coverage
corrections.fix: Executable task fixtures load a helper from bytes and emit/invoke a dynamic assembly.
corrections.regression: Both successfully write execution markers before fileless provenance refuses.

corrections.finding: Model replay/dispatcher evidence overclaims durability or endpoint qualification
corrections.fix: Contributor guide, dated report and selected ledger resolutions explicitly distinguish callback model replay from durable-store transactions and direct dispatcher tests from endpoint administrator verification.
corrections.followup: The pre-existing endpoint/DW-21 owner-bound verifier qualification remains open and unchanged.

corrections.finding: Tracer must preserve SIGTRAP and retry EINTR
corrections.fix: Deliver ordinary tracee SIGTRAP; suppress only ptrace event traps. Retry interrupted initial and descendant waits.
corrections.regression: Native SIGTRAP termination status remains 133; a native preload shim injects EINTR into both wait sites and tracing completes successfully.

corrections.finding: Genuine SIGSTOP was swallowed with attachment stops
corrections.fix: Pipe-held initial child attached with PTRACE_SEIZE/PTRACE_INTERRUPT; genuine group stops use PTRACE_LISTEN. Synthetic PTRACE_EVENT_STOP traps are distinguished from real signal delivery. No WCONTINUED events are requested.
corrections.regression: A parent forks a child that raises SIGSTOP; parent waitpid(WUNTRACED) sees that stop and sends SIGCONT. Direct and traced executions both exit 0.
corrections.preserved: Detached descendants are awaited; actual package atomic-restoration mutation still refuses.
